description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering performance tracker log search results. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes a property for the tracker ID, along with sort options.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters specific to performance tracker log searches, including sorting options and tracker ID filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting field and order.

methods.name: getTrackerId
methods.description: Returns the tracker ID filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setTrackerId
methods.description: Sets the tracker ID filter value.
